purpose: Executable ledger for the `unitarity-causality-stability` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Causality-cone rows make microcausality, analyticity, causal order, hyperbolicity, signal timing, and light-cone language auditable; they can cap or roll back support but cannot promote a route beyond its own ceiling.

causality_rows.superluminal_or_acausal_failure_mode: Failure can appear as superluminal modes, acausal commutators, wrong analyticity domain, nonhyperbolic propagation, closed causal loops, trigger-order artifacts, or background-dependent cone mismatch.
causality_rows.causality_test: Stress-test the route under cone changes, analytic continuation, background/sector variation, detector timing, or commutator support; cap causal wording if the test is not route-native.
causality_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer causal consistency, locality, analyticity, or physical signal propagation merely from a well-fit likelihood, gauge-fixed equation, gluing diagram, or formal model.
